items.headline: Manchester United close to signing Barcelona left-back Alejandro Balde
items.summary: United have offer on table for Balde as Barcelona push exit. Balde authorized agent Jorge Mendes to negotiate departure. Move could happen before window closes.

items.headline: Manchester United to open negotiations for Alejandro Balde with Barcelona
items.summary: Man United monitoring left-back Balde due to Luke Shaw injury concerns. Direct talks with agent Jorge Mendes expected soon. Balde made 60 LaLiga appearances.

items.headline: Manchester United edge closer to Alejandro Balde transfer
items.summary: United have offer on table for Balde. Left-back omitted from Barcelona's matchday squad. Seeking left-back upgrade with Shaw injury concerns.
